title: A Mud Volcano Has Erupted Nonstop for 20 Years

scenes.text: One mud volcano has been erupting for twenty years.
It started in May 2006 in Indonesia, and it's called Lusi.
At its peak, it spat out one hundred eighty thousand cubic meters of mud a day.
The mud buried villages under up to forty meters, and tens of thousands of people lost their homes.
And twenty years later, it still hasn't stopped.

description:
One mud volcano has been erupting for twenty years.
Lusi in Indonesia began erupting in May 2006, once released about 180,000 cubic meters of mud a day, and is still erupting today.
What do you think it would take to stop it?
first_comment: Twenty years and counting. How long do you think it keeps going?
